scripts.docker:dev:reset: docker compose -f compose.dev.yaml --env-file .env.dev down && docker volume rm armali-dev_api_node_modules armali-dev_api_workspace_modules armali-dev_web_node_modules armali-dev_web_workspace_modules armali-dev_schemas_node_modules ; docker compose -f compose.dev.yaml --env-file .env.dev up -d --build
scripts.db:init: pnpm --filter api prisma:generate && pnpm --filter api prisma:migrate && pnpm db:seed
scripts.sync:api: docker compose -f compose.dev.yaml --env-file .env.dev exec api pnpm install
scripts.sync:web: docker compose -f compose.dev.yaml --env-file .env.dev exec web pnpm install
